name: Toro
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

notes: Very cold winters, long sunny days and extreme temperatures give wines with structure and high alcohol.
The reds show red and black fruit, with medium to full body and balanced alcohol and acidity.
Barrel-aged reds, from Roble to Gran Reserva, add oak aromas as they age.
The whites are light in body, with fruity, floral or herbal aromas and medium to fairly high acidity.

blurb.text: A DO in the southeast of Zamora province, in western Castile and León, that also takes in a few villages in Valladolid province. Its rules allow red Tempranillo and Garnacha Tinta, and white Verdejo, Doña Blanca, Albillo Real and Muscat Blanc.
